description.narrative: GreenAL aims to nurture and empower Albanian environmental CSOs to actively participate and contribute to the process of aligning legislation with the EU Acquis and negotiations, with the main focus on Chapter 27. Main actions of GreenAL include 1) launching and implementation of the four calls: thematic, regional, initiative (targeting grassroot organisations) and on the spot grants; 2) Dedicated training and coaching activities with the selected grantees on project cycle management, administrative, gender mainstreaming, financial and communication issues; 3) Establish and further nurture a growing network of environmental CSOs to undertake Green-AL Policy Influencing Campaigns. 4) Draft the Yearly Status report on Green Transition and EU Integration related to cluster 4 in Albania. 5) Draft and disseminate the yearly Pollution (Green Lungs) Status Report based on evidence-based data monitored through different sites, etc.

GreenAL syftar till att främja och stärka albanska civilsamhällesorganisationer på miljöområdet så att de aktivt kan delta och bidra till processen för att anpassa lagstiftningen till EU:s regelverk och förhandlingar, med huvudfokus på kapitel 27. De viktigaste åtgärderna inom GreenAL omfattar 1) lansering och genomförande av de fyra ansökningsomgångarna: tematiska, regionala, initiativ (som riktar sig till gräsrotsorganisationer) och bidrag på plats; 2) Särskild utbildning och handledning med de utvalda bidragsmottagarna om projektcykelförvaltning, administrativa frågor, jämställdhetsintegrering, finansiella frågor och kommunikationsfrågor. 3) Etablera och ytterligare vårda ett växande nätverk av civilsamhällesorganisationer på miljöområdet för att genomföra påverkanskampanjer för miljö-AL-politiken. 4) Utarbeta den årliga lägesrapporten om grön omställning och EU-integration relaterad till kluster 4 i Albanien. 5) Utarbeta och sprida den årliga statusrapporten om föroreningar (gröna lungor) baserat på evidensbaserade data som övervakas på olika platser, etc.

The overall objective of the proposed intervention is nurturing and further empowering Albanian environmental CSOs for effective participation and contribution vis a vie EU acquis and negotiations processes in Albania with regard to chapter 27 as well as proactively contribute to address, through advocacy, policy-influencing and evidence-based data monitoring, the environmental challenges from local to national levels with regard to Climate, Nature and Pollution.
The intervention has three specific objectives (long-term results):
1) Nurture and further empower E-CSOs in Albania by strengthening their capacities to proactively address environmental issues and further consolidate their legitimacy to better represent their cause and/or affected communities.
2) Stimulate/ encourage the active involvement and meaningful contribution of E-CSOs inthe ongoing and future processes related to acquis and green transition taking place at both national and local levels.
3) Contribute to increasing awareness and accountability on Climate Change, Nature Protection, and Depollution challenges among policy decision-making stakeholders and the public at large in Albania through advocacy, policy-influencing and evidence-based data monitoring.

During 2025, GreenAL strengthened the role and capacity of environmental civil society in Albania through network building, policy engagement, capacity development, and grant support.
The GreenAL CSO Network was formalized and expanded to 77 member organizations, creating a structured platform for coordination, advocacy, awareness-raising, and engagement in environmental governance. Through national forums and other joint activities, the network brought together CSOs, communities, public institutions, donors, and international actors to discuss environmental challenges and promote civil society participation in decision-making processes.
The network supported CSO contributions to Albania's EU integration and Green Agenda processes, including input to the EU Progress Report, monitoring of environmental policies, and engagement in discussions on green transition priorities. It also facilitated joint environmental actions and advocacy efforts, helping raise public and institutional attention to local environmental concerns.
GreenAL strengthened the capacities of environmental CSOs through targeted training and mentoring. Two training programmes on the Green Agenda, climate policies, biodiversity, and protected area management were delivered in 2025, reaching 153 participants from CSOs, community groups, and environmental professionals.
Through three grant schemes, GreenAL provided support to 63 environmental CSOs and 41 initiatives across the country. The grants enabled organizations to undertake advocacy, awareness-raising, community engagement, and environmental monitoring activities while receiving continuous technical support, training, and mentoring.
Examples of results achieved at output level:
Output 2 (OP2): Accountable and well-structured community/network of Environmental CSOs actively involved/engaged in the ongoing processes related to the EU integration and Green Transition in Albania through meaningful contribution towards an increased public perception of environmental issues
1) Influence on Albania's EU Integration Process (Cluster 4)
Linked with the influencing of Cluster 4 of Albania's EU integration process, GreenAL realized two contributions to the EU Progress Reports through GreenAL CSOs. These contributions covered all sub-chapters of Cluster 4, including Energy, Transport, Climate Change, and Environment.
GreenAL network organizations participated in the EU Delegation (EUD) roundtables together with environmental organizations such as REC Albania, Milieukontakt, PPNEA, AOS, ETMI, and CoPLAN. Through these roundtables, they raised the most pressing environmental issues, highlighting both existing gaps in implementation and the initiatives undertaken by institutional actors to advance the EU integration process in alignment with EU environmental directives.
As a result, the 2025 EU Progress Report reflected contributions and recommendations put forward by the GreenAL Network.
2) Policy Responses on Environment, Energy, and Climate
Under this result area, four Policy Responses were finalized during the reporting period, while two additional Policy Responses in the process of publication during this reported period.
During the first year of the project, CoPLAN developed two Policy Responses based on the findings and discussions from roundtables on energy and climate issues, as well as data collected on air pollution in Tirana. These Policy Responses provide evidence and recommendations on key environmental and climate-related challenges identified through the project activities.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
